SHARED.ERROR: Something went wrong. Your changes have been preserved.

MAIN.SELECT_ITEM_AT_LOCATION: Select the object at this location.

STARTUP.TITLE: Osm Go! could not start
STARTUP.REQUIRED_RESOURCE_FAILED: A required application resource could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.
STARTUP.CORRUPTED_STORAGE: The local map data is unreadable. Retry first, or reset it if the problem persists. Resetting clears the downloaded data and pending edits from the app and keeps a backup copy on this device when it can.
STARTUP.QUARANTINE_NOTICE: Some local objects were unreadable and were set aside ({{count}}). You can export them from the upload screen.
STARTUP.RESET_FAILED: Your data could not be backed up: nothing was deleted.

MAP_INITIALIZATION.TITLE: The map could not start
MAP_INITIALIZATION.STYLE_FAILED: The map style could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.
MAP_INITIALIZATION.WEBGL_REQUIRED: WebGL 2 is required to display the map on this device.
MAP_INITIALIZATION.CREATION_FAILED: The map could not be created. Try again, or restart the application if the problem persists.

STACK.LABEL: Objects at this spot
STACK.LIST: Show all objects at this spot
STACK.POSITION: {{index}} / {{count}}, show all objects at this spot

SELECTION.REVERT_LOCAL_MESSAGE: This object will go back to the version last downloaded from OpenStreetMap.
SELECTION.REVERT_LOCAL_MESSAGE_CREATED: This new object has not been uploaded yet and will be deleted.
SELECTION.REVERT_LOCAL_MESSAGE_DELETED: The object will no longer be marked for deletion.

BUTTONS.CENTER_GPS: Center the map on my location

LOCATION.DENIED: Location access is blocked. Allow it in your device settings to see your position.
LOCATION.UNAVAILABLE: Your position is not available right now. Check that location is turned on.

SW.INSTALLATION_FAILED: The new version could not be installed.
SW.UNRECOVERABLE: The app needs to reload to keep working.
SW.EXTERNAL_STATE: The data was changed in another tab. Reload to continue.

MAIN.LINKED_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The linked object was not found in the downloaded data.

MENU.LOGIN_ERROR: Could not start the OpenStreetMap login. Check your connection and try again.

SEND_DATA.YOU_MUST_BE_LOGGED_IN: Please log in to upload your changes to OSM.
SEND_DATA.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: The changes to {{count}} objects will be permanently lost. This cannot be undone.
SEND_DATA.DONT_CLOSE: Please do not close this page
SEND_DATA.DISCARD_ATTEMPT_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Only continue if you verified that OpenStreetMap did not apply this attempt. The submitted changes will become editable and uploadable again.

ERRORS.EMPTY_QUEUE: There are no local changes to upload.
ERRORS.INVALID_QUEUE: The local upload queue contains invalid or conflicting data.
ERRORS.CONNECTION: OpenStreetMap could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
ERRORS.AUTHENTICATION: OpenStreetMap authentication failed. Sign in again before retrying.
ERRORS.CHANGESET_CLOSED: The changeset is closed. Retry to create a new changeset.
ERRORS.CHANGESET: The changeset could not be prepared.
ERRORS.JOURNAL: The upload recovery journal could not be saved.
ERRORS.UPLOAD_REJECTED: OpenStreetMap rejected this upload. Correct the affected changes before retrying.
ERRORS.UPLOAD_UNCERTAIN: The upload result is uncertain. Inspect OpenStreetMap before continuing.
ERRORS.RECONCILIATION: The OpenStreetMap response could not be reconciled with the local queue.
ERRORS.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: A previous upload may have reached OpenStreetMap. Inspect it before continuing.
ERRORS.LEGACY_JOURNAL: This older recovery journal cannot be reconciled automatically.
ERRORS.INTEGRITY: The saved upload snapshot failed its integrity check.
ERRORS.LOCAL_CHANGE: The local changes could not be updated.
ERRORS.UNKNOWN: OpenStreetMap could not process the request.
ERRORS.COMMENT_TOO_LONG: The changeset comment is longer than 255 characters. Shorten it and try again.
ERRORS.FORBIDDEN: OpenStreetMap does not allow this account to edit (missing permission or blocked account). Sign in again and check your account on openstreetmap.org.
ERRORS.VERSION_CONFLICT: This object was modified on OpenStreetMap since you downloaded it.
ERRORS.NODE_STILL_REFERENCED: This object is still used by a line or a relation. It will be sent without its tags: retry the upload.
ERRORS.UPLOAD_ELSEWHERE: An upload is already running in another window.
ERRORS.STALE_STATE: The data was changed in another window. Reload the application before uploading.
ERRORS.RECEIPT_NOT_SAVED: OpenStreetMap accepted the changes but the result could not be saved on this device. Do not send again: free some storage, then resume.
ERRORS.LOGIN_FAILED: The sign-in could not be started.

ACTIONS.CHECK_ACCOUNT: Sign in again and check that your account can edit

SEND_DATA.VERIFICATION_NOT_FOUND: No trace of this upload was found in the changeset.
SEND_DATA.VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: OpenStreetMap could not be checked. Check again once online, or inspect the changeset.
SEND_DATA.VERIFICATION_PARTIAL: The changeset only contains part of this upload. An upload is applied as a whole: inspect the changeset on OpenStreetMap, then export the recovery data to consider it applied.
SEND_DATA.REBASE_CHANGE: Reapply my changes on the current version
SEND_DATA.REBASE_DONE: Your changes were reapplied on the current version. Upload again.
SEND_DATA.REBASE_UP_TO_DATE: This object has not changed on OpenStreetMap since your download. Upload again.
SEND_DATA.REBASE_GONE: This object was deleted on OpenStreetMap. Cancel your change.
SEND_DATA.REBASE_FAILED: The current version could not be fetched. Try again.
SEND_DATA.REBASE_CONFLICT_STRUCTURE: Its nodes or members changed on OpenStreetMap: your change cannot be reapplied here. Cancel it, then edit the current version.
SEND_DATA.CONFLICT_LOADING: Comparing with the current OpenStreetMap version…
SEND_DATA.CONFLICT_UNAVAILABLE: The current version could not be loaded. You can still try to reapply your changes.
SEND_DATA.CONFLICT_HELP_CHOOSE: Highlighted values are kept. Choose a value for each tag changed on both sides, then apply your choices.
SEND_DATA.CONFLICT_HELP_MERGE: Highlighted values are kept: your changes can be reapplied on the current version.
SEND_DATA.MARK_APPLIED: Consider as applied and remove from the queue
SEND_DATA.MARK_APPLIED_CONFIRM_HEADER: Remove this upload from the queue?
SEND_DATA.MARK_APPLIED_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Only continue if OpenStreetMap already holds these changes. They leave the local queue and a copy stays in the exported recovery data. Download the area again afterwards.
SEND_DATA.ATTEMPT_ABANDONED: The upload was removed from the queue.
SEND_DATA.STALE_WINDOW: The data was changed in another window. Reload the application to keep working.
SEND_DATA.QUARANTINE_MESSAGE: {{count}} local objects were unreadable and set aside. Export them to keep a copy of what could not be recovered.
SEND_DATA.QUARANTINE_DISMISS_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: The unreadable objects will be deleted from this device. Only continue if you exported them.
SEND_DATA.EXPORT_FAILED: The file could not be exported.
SEND_DATA.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE_ONE: The change to this object will be permanently lost. This cannot be undone.
SEND_DATA.VERIFICATION_WAIT: OpenStreetMap may still apply a slow request: check again in {{seconds}} s before it can be marked as not applied.
SEND_DATA.VERIFICATION_CHECK_NOW: Check again to confirm that this upload was not applied.
SEND_DATA.STATE_BACKUP_MESSAGE: Local data was set aside by a reset or a change of server. Export it to keep a copy of the changes it contains.

SETTINGS.POSITION_TRACKING_HINT: The map is centered at your location.
SETTINGS.ORIENTATION_TRACKING_HINT: The orientation of the map depends on the device.
SETTINGS.HIDE_LARGE_POLYGON_HINT: Polygons larger than 5000 m² won't be displayed. A marker will always represent the polygon.
SETTINGS.HIDE_LONG_LINE_HINT: Lines longer than 200 m won't be displayed. A marker will always represent the line.
SETTINGS.MARGIN_HINT: Distance around the current view where the data will be downloaded.
SETTINGS.TAG_COUNTRY_HINT: Tags and presets may vary by country.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CACHE_HINT: Delete everything in the app cache: data, edits, login, etc.
SETTINGS.DISPLAY_OLD_TAGS_ICON: Show an icon on old objects
SETTINGS.OLD_TAGS_ICON_RANGE_PART_1: The last modification of the object happened at least

SETTINGS.DISPLAY_FIXME_ICON_HINT: Displays an icon to the right of the marker to indicate the presence of a fixme tag.
SETTINGS.ADD_SURVEY_DATE_HINT: Sets the chosen survey date tag to today’s date each time an object is added or edited.
SETTINGS.LINES_SELECTABLE_HINT: Ability to click on a line to open the element sheet.
SETTINGS.POLYGONS_SELECTABLE_HINT: Ability to click on a polygon to open the element sheet.
SETTINGS.SWITCH_SERVER_MESSAGE: Changing server deletes every pending local edit. This cannot be undone.
SETTINGS.CENTER_WHEN_GPS_IS_READY: On start, center the map on your location
SETTINGS.CENTER_WHEN_GPS_IS_READY_HINT: Center the map on your location as soon as possible.
SETTINGS.OPEN_OBJECT_SHEET_AS_PREVIEW_HINT: Opens the object sheet halfway so the map stays visible. Otherwise it opens full screen.
SETTINGS.LIMIT_FEATURES: Maximum number of objects in memory
SETTINGS.LIMIT_FEATURES_HINT: After this limit, the old data will be deleted (the current modifications will be kept). Too high a limit can dramatically decrease performance
SETTINGS.DISPLAY_SURVEY_CARD_HINT: Makes it easy to record the survey date of an object.
SETTINGS.SURVEY_CARD_RANGE: Show when the last update was more than {{year}} years ago
SETTINGS.UPLOAD_IN_PROGRESS: An upload is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CACHE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Downloaded data, preferences, login and remembered fields will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CACHE_PENDING_ONE: 1 change that has not been uploaded to OpenStreetMap will be lost.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CACHE_PENDING_MANY: {{count}} changes that have not been uploaded to OpenStreetMap will be lost.
SETTINGS.DELETE_CACHE_UNRESOLVED_UPLOAD: A previous upload is not fully reconciled yet. Deleting the cache erases its recovery record and may lead to duplicates on OpenStreetMap.
SETTINGS.DEV_SERVER_HINT: After this change, the application will restart and the data will be cleared.
SETTINGS.SWITCH_SERVER_MESSAGE_CLEAN: Changing server signs you out, clears the downloaded data and restarts the application.
SETTINGS.AERIAL_IMAGERY_ERROR: Aerial imagery could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
SETTINGS.SWITCH_SERVER_UNRESOLVED_UPLOAD: A previous upload is not fully reconciled yet. Changing server erases its recovery record and may lead to duplicates on OpenStreetMap.
SETTINGS.SWITCH_SERVER_FAILED: Your data could not be backed up, so the server was not changed.
